evidence.observation: The canonical product contract, current Surface, assurance ledger, audit index, package tree, and operations guide expose the conversational, execution, evidence, workflow, cockpit, and recovery owners without making historical audit generations current authority.
evidence.excerpt: Lattice is a local-first conversational lattice harness

evidence.observation: Typed direct and role-session actors, stateless context assemblies, route-specific batch members, execution profiles, confirmation hashes, and immutable receipts model conversation as the kernel primitive while workflows remain optional governed layers.
The same-origin REST boundary carries typed project, batch, episode, trailhead, navigation, exact-slice, workflow, and compatibility operations without exposing another graph authority.

An implementation boundary separate from the compositor independently validates v2-v9 manifests, provider-facing ancestry attribution, exact user bytes, and the manifest-bound Claude system-instruction channel.
evidence.excerpt: Verify a durable manifest or a stateless batch candidate independently.

evidence.observation: Foreground graph reads use bounded pagination and stable cursors while large payloads remain content-addressed; dormant trailheads remain reachable without whole-history reconstruction.
evidence.excerpt: ORDER BY created_at DESC,invocation_id DESC LIMIT ?

evidence.observation: Snapshot creation refuses active work and symlinked sources, copies SQLite consistently, binds a state digest, inventories reachable files, and restores through an isolated verified staging root.
evidence.excerpt: Publish one complete snapshot only after its database and file inventory verify.

evidence.observation: Batch idempotency, preview compare-and-swap, all-or-none sealing, append events, and route-specific manifests share one SQLite transaction; leases and retries remain separate immutable attempts.
evidence.excerpt: Persist every sealed invocation in one transaction before any provider attempt can begin.

evidence.observation: Loopback host checks, same-origin sessions, CSRF, mode-0600 CLI capability, security headers, and no-CORS defaults constrain local mutations and iframe authority.
Doctor diagnostics independently distinguish Outport, launchd, service, schema, append-chain, blobs, journals, provider profiles, runtime attestation, backup, and active-work state.
The public CLI exposes serve, open, status, doctor, backup, and isolated restore with structured output and actionable nonzero failure exits while Outport remains service authority.

Installation forcibly rebuilds local packages, independently inventories source and installed trees, publishes a non-editable versioned runtime, installs an Interactive main launchd service, probes the exact generation, and rolls back failed publication.

The response and composer remain primary while dual routing, exact selections, side quests, return, comparison, trailheads, context delta, and typed secondary failures remain available without workflow or graph setup.
evidence.excerpt: Keep the exact selection alive while the operator uses its action menu.

evidence.observation: The immutable finding ledger routes all 24 discriminated product, architecture, S1, and S2 findings to implementation receipts, independent oracles, and false mutations; every record is closed.

Authenticated Claude and Codex acceptance passed 78 semantic assertions over 18 immutable invocations, including direct conversation, side quest, dual fan-out, exact graft, reciprocal cross-feed, join, native continuation and fork, provider recovery, launchd restart, and final responsiveness.
Playwright completed the freestyle one-edge conversational path and independently planted secondary-surface failures without erasing the primary response or composer.
evidence.excerpt: browser regression: secondary surface outages do not erase the conversation

evidence.observation: The selected non-editable runtime attests Lattice cb5e27b and model-runner eeef1ba; repository changes from cb5e27b through the audited revision affect only documentation and generated assurance surfaces, not installed application bytes.

The installed doctor independently passed Outport, launchd, responsive service, schema-9 database, append history, blobs, journals, exact non-editable runtime, all qualified Claude/Codex profiles, and readable backup with no active work.
The post-acceptance SQLite-consistent snapshot restored into an isolated root with the identical canonical state digest and retained every manifest, blob, journal, and projection reference.

The predecessor audit independently observed that the healthy selected runtime was still generation 0.1.0-5fce638f and therefore could not substantiate the then-current conversation-first source claims.
evidence.excerpt: The supervised service does not run the audited conversation-first generation

owner_sources.excerpt: Real personal data is not imported automatically. Closure means the system has survived synthetic, sanitized, authenticated-provider, restart, and restore testing and is ready for the user to begin real-data operation.

prior_art.description: The retrieved Lattice product contract compares linear chat, visual workflows, durable runners, Dandelion, Loom, and agent session managers by node scale and progressive graph authorship.

mechanisms.mechanism: The design adapts graph branching and session control but keeps the next conversational edge, not a predefined workflow or whole job, as the human-authored primitive.

prior_art.description: The product contract separates Smithers-scale job recovery and model-runner execution durability from Lattice-owned prompt, topology, and context semantics.

mechanisms.mechanism: Lattice reuses immutable journals, leases, and resumability below the graph while refusing to make job or provider sessions the canonical conversation identity.

findings.title: The supervised service runs the verified v0.2.0 conversation-first generation
findings.claim: The launchd-selected runtime binds the exact Lattice and model-runner implementation commits that passed authenticated acceptance, browser acceptance, doctor, backup, and isolated restore; later audited-revision changes are non-runtime assurance and documentation bytes.
findings.failure_mode: The prior generation's healthy-but-old service would have made every current-source product claim false at the operator-visible Outport identity.
findings.consequence: That runtime/source split is removed: deliberate personal operation now exercises the independently attested v0.2.0 implementation rather than a predecessor.
findings.response: Verified by immutable runtime attestation, current-source acceptance, exact browser acceptance, final doctor, and isolated snapshot restore; retain runtime compare-and-swap and doctor disagreement gates permanently.

adversarial_passes.scope: Independent manifest reconstruction, generated-object validators, hand-authored fixtures, browser interception, authenticated provider semantics, runtime tree attestation, doctor probes, and isolated restore attack the compositor, supervisor, cockpit, installer, and ledger claims through distinct boundaries.

mutations.statement: Secretly require or inject a role into a direct invocation.
mutations.oracle: The hand-authored direct-context oracle, independent manifest reader, and blank-project acceptance reject role bytes or a role prerequisite.

mutations.statement: Give one fan-out child different semantic context or omit its route-specific capabilities.
mutations.oracle: The shared ContextAssembly hash and per-route manifest oracle reject divergent semantic assemblies or missing capabilities before execution.

mutations.statement: Let an optional graph, workflow, episode, or Slate outage erase the primary response.
mutations.oracle: The browser regression plants secondary 503 responses and retains the selected response and composer.

mutations.statement: Relabel a Codex parent as Claude while recomputing the manifest hashes.
mutations.oracle: The independent reader resolves the producing invocation and rejects the false harness attribution.

mutations.statement: Swap or omit the Claude system protocol after manifest sealing.
mutations.oracle: The independent reader and model-runner checkpoint loader bind the exact system bytes and reject the forged generation.

mutations.statement: Return a process-successful refusal instead of performing a requested cross-feed.
mutations.oracle: Authenticated acceptance requires route-specific semantic markers and cannot publish a pass for a refusal.

mutations.statement: Serve a runtime generation different from the selected and Outport-bound generation.
mutations.oracle: Runtime tree attestation, live generation probes, and doctor reject source, selected-runtime, or listener disagreement.

mutations.statement: Classify the main synchronous service as a launchd Background process or accept a slow final health response.
mutations.oracle: The plist contract requires Interactive for the main service and authenticated acceptance rejects unavailable or >=2-second final health.

mutations.statement: Remove a referenced blob and report snapshot restore success.
mutations.oracle: Snapshot inventory assessment and isolated restore reject incomplete content before publication.

mutations.statement: Resume a provider-native session across model, workspace, or permission boundaries.
mutations.oracle: Qualification and authenticated acceptance reject continuation unless provider, model, workspace, selected ancestry, and authority match.

closure_claims.statement: A blank project supports direct Claude/Codex conversation, side quests, fan-out, exact excerpt grafting, reciprocal cross-feed, fan-in, dormant-branch resumption, and live Slate tagging without role or workflow setup.

Every consequential route preserves independently reconstructable provider bytes, source harness identity, selected ancestry, route-specific capabilities, manifest-bound Claude system instructions, and explicit provider opacity.

Outport, launchd, non-editable runtime attestation, responsive health, durable ledger, provider recovery, snapshots, and isolated restore keep Lattice recoverable independently of Panels, browser, provider, or development checkout failure.
All 24 discriminated remediation findings retain implementation receipts, independent oracles, and rejected false mutations, and no in-scope S0-S2 finding remains active.

residuals.statement: This continuation closes the predecessor's runtime blockers at sanity depth across all twelve Audit Planes; it does not claim exhaustive line traversal, calibrated recall, or the absence of unknown defects.

Provider-owned system, administration, memory, and service-side context remain observable only through each official CLI's declared proof limits; Lattice proves its own exact input channels and labels the rest opaque.
The German quaternary workflow retains its deterministic and role-governed contracts, but authenticated Gemini native-role qualification is unavailable and is not counted as v0.2.0 proof.

No real personal corpus was imported because the approved closure boundary requires readiness before deliberate admission; synthetic and sanitized data prove the machinery, not the semantics of a future personal corpus.
Outport's upstream Go suite was not rerun because the host lacks the Go toolchain; Lattice's independent Outport resolution, listener disagreement, and installed doctor contracts passed.
